description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
